name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build a Qiskit Aer noise model with depolariz
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build a Qiskit Aer noise model with depolarizing error 0.01 on single-qubit gates and 0.0176 on CX. Run a 3-qubit GHZ circuit with 4096 shots and compare noisy vs ideal counts. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
